name: motel-cmb-53
description: Motel CMB 53 — Room Booking Management System

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.docker:fresh: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
